name: Sessehshellah
description: The Sessehshellah, or Sesseh, were a fierce aboriginal race of mustalids native to the planet Shaymore. Though skilled at swimming, combat, and stealth, the Sessehshellah had little in the way of advanced technology; resultantly, they were easy prey for the Galactic Empire, which exploited Shaymore's hydrocarbons. The Sessehshellah were subsequently aided by the Rebel Alliance, who supplied them with modern weapons; both parties worked together in a successful bid to derail the hydrocarbon extraction effort and force the Imperials off Shaymore.
